_comment: Five personas + permissions + presets. Used by mission-control's persona switcher, per-app role-gating, and the super-admin user directory. Phase 1 stubs all but agent + consumer. As of 2026-05-05 (admin-console init), the canonical badge list lives in badges.json; the `permissions` array on each persona below is shorthand and SHOULD be kept in sync with the corresponding `presets.<persona>.badges` entry in badges.json. Long-term (Phase 2), this file becomes a thin reference: persona → preset_id → badges.json.presets[preset_id].badges. As of 2026-05-08-presets-promotion (Wave 20), the per-persona `presets` array is promoted from mission-control/src/fixtures/persona-presets.json into canon (was W19 Task 6 _CANON_TODO).
_tag_permission_principle: Tags sync bi-directionally with GHL (per architecture/07-data-layer.md). To prevent the GHL tag namespace from sprawling, the create vs. apply permissions are split: any org role can `add_tags` (apply existing tags to a contact), but only manager+ roles can `create_tags` (mint a new tag). Agents must search-existing-only. Consumer never tags.
_presets_principle: Each persona carries a `presets` array of named permission templates. UI: when an admin assigns a user to a persona, they pick a preset from a dropdown; the preset determines which badges (subset of canon/badges.json) get applied. Per-user `added_badges` / `removed_badges` overrides remain on the user record (not on presets). Exactly one preset per persona may carry `is_default: true` — UI seeds new users on the default. Presets are platform-wide today; org-overrides (e.g., 'Apex agent_lead overrides canonical agent_lead for org 102 only') are an open question — see _TODO. Consumer persona deliberately omits presets (consumers don't sit in mc UserDirectory).

_presets_shape.id: string — stable snake_case id, globally unique within the persona
_presets_shape.label: string — human display label (sentence case)
_presets_shape.badges: string[] — subset of canon/badges.json badge ids
_presets_shape.is_default: boolean? — exactly one preset per persona may carry true; UI seeds new users on this preset

super_admin.label: Super Admin
super_admin.description: Blinker-internal. Cross-org visibility, audit logs, sensitive ops, canon edits, integration credential reveals.

presets.label: Full Super Admin
presets.description: Every super-admin badge. Default for new super-admin users.

presets.label: Read-only Super Admin
presets.description: Cross-org visibility + audit access without write or impersonation.

admin.label: Org Admin
admin.description: Organization administrator. Configures the org, manages users + integrations + sub-orgs, edits org config, toggles test mode (with confirm).

presets.label: Full Org Admin
presets.description: Standard org admin. Manages users, integrations, sub-orgs, and config.

presets.label: User Admin
presets.description: Limited admin focused on user lifecycle. No integration or config edits.

presets.label: Billing Admin
presets.description: Org config + integrations focus, no user management.

manager.label: Manager
manager.description: Manager at the org level. Manages agents but can't edit org-level configs. Has analytics access.

presets.label: Standard Manager
presets.description: Manages a team of agents with full team analytics.

presets.label: Lead Manager
presets.description: Senior manager — adds API-response visibility for triage.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: Sales agent. Daily-driver. Works the opportunity inbox + co-pilot with consumers.

presets.label: Standard Agent
presets.description: Daily-driver opportunity inbox + co-pilot. Default for new agents.

presets.label: Lead Agent
presets.description: Tenured agent — adds API-response visibility and tag creation for handling escalations.

presets.label: Agent / Admin Assistant
presets.description: Agent who also helps with org-config admin tasks. Subset of admin badges layered on agent.

consumer.label: Consumer
consumer.description: End customer. Uses the customer-facing portals (customer-portal, *-portal customer views). Not a mission-control persona.
